editorial.blurb: A neighborhood gem where genuine pride shines through in every carefully crafted bowl—Vietnamese cooking that tastes like home and heals like medicine.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Beef Pho with the spicy version for maximum depth; reviewers rave about the perfectly sliced fresh beef and transformative broth that pairs beautifully with their house-made spring roll sauce.

topDishes.note: Fresh, perfectly sliced beef in an amazing broth that cures what ails you
